bugs.detail: O1 NOT fixed for the slow-clarification path. The book tool deterministically returns status=rejected / next_step=reoffer_slots on genuinely-open, freshly-offered slots (martes 16 jun 10:00 AND 11:20 with Marta), both confirmed open by availability_service (15 slots found for stylist on 2026-06-16). Reproduced on 3 distinct book calls across 2 different slots — systemic, not slot-specific, not transient. Root cause is the J3 slot-binding guard validate_slot_in_offered(start_iso, stylist_id, state.recently_offered_slots) at agent/tools/book.py:373-388: the offered slots are presented to the user but the corresponding state.recently_offered_slots binding does not match (the iso/stylist key the LLM passes to book is not present in recently_offered_slots), so J3 rejects. The earlier update_booking call also returned tool.response.partial -> reoffer_slots with pre_resolved_ids=[cb7ae91c-97ff-e1d1-3b0b-696b11467add]. No invalid_service_ids fired.
